core_points.reason: This node captures the section's opening concept: predicate crimes generate proceeds that may be laundered, while jurisdictional differences create AML compliance risk.
The 21 numbered units form one review-list core_point: they are examples within one FATF classification set rather than separate conceptual nodes.
